translation:
I'm really sorry about before. I didn't mean to
cause so much confusion…
Confusion? What do you mean?

I caused a big misunderstanding when I was
crying in the computer society room…

Ah, that. Don't worry about it—water under
the bridge.

But because of that, I made you angry and
stuff…

That's not true. I was angry at the computer
society—you were totally innocent, Mikuru.

Well, I guess they weren't exactly in the wrong
either though.

After that, the thing with their data getting
lost—I heard about the apology.
Apology? From who?
Kyon and Nagato…
Hold on, this is the first I've heard of that.

Umm, back then you got angry because of me,
and then the socket—

I don't need details, just tell me what
happened next.

Then… they lost all their data, and I heard
that those two went and apologized.
And by "those two,” you mean Kyon and Yuki?
Yes. That's what I heard.

I don't think Yuki would do that voluntarily, so
it must've been Kyon's idea…

Offering an apology without getting consent
from the brigade chief is a major issue!
Kyon's going to need a serious scolding later.

N-no way! Kyon was just making things right
after the trouble we caused…
You're wrong about that, Mikuru.

Everything would've worked out fine if they
had just clearly explained the situation.

Their failure to clear up the misunderstanding
is on them, so both sides are in the wrong.

[#P06I] feel like we were the only ones in the wrong
though…
What was that?

I can't hear you—you're gonna need to
speak up.
N-nothing!

What was Kyon thinking, getting Yuki
involved?

Well, whatever. We'll deal with all of this in our
evaluation meeting after the summer camp.

W-we're going to have an evaluation
meeting…?

Depends on how I feel at the time. For now,
let's just meet up with Kyon and the others.
I hope I was able to buy you some time.
Do your best, Kyon.
